# jaws-v1 candidate pool — strategist, 2026-11-20 (saved by Jarvis; the agent cannot write files)

Answer: Unsettled Mariner in / Ceremonial Knife out stays first. Pool adds three that earn a slot: Cavalier of Gales, Channeled Force, Kindred Discovery. Cuts other than the Knife are role-based guesses. Did not read the recon or the branch role tags.

1. Mariner for Knife — changeling (Human + Shark), taxes targeted spells on Shabraz (the protect step), the early blocker 009 lacked. Knife's Blood token is the discard-to-draw step the pilot rejected. No inclusion signal for Mariner (argument only).
2. Cavalier of Gales for Collective Defiance — 5-mana flyer, draws three (three counters, three life), tucks two back (not a discard); body + draw-three + recursive. Defiance's discard-then-draw mode is the laborious step.
3. Channeled Force for Prismari Command — discard X, draw X, X damage to a creature: draw and removal in one card; the only pool card that fixes thin interaction AND draws. Wants a full hand.
4. Kindred Discovery (Shark) for a Talisman — draws on enter or attack; Shabraz attacks every turn; Shark Typhoon tokens draw as they enter. Check Shabraz is a Shark. Rock-cut caution: Sol Ring/Signets stay, lands ≥ 35.
5. Tolarian Winds for Fellwar Stone — 2-mana instant draw-seven-ish; fixes a land-heavy keep like 009; value tracks hand size (strategy:card-advantage.plan-draw).
6. Narset, Jeskai Waymaster for Training Center — 3-mana WUR Human; discard optional; marginal.

Library of Leng: NO. Thought Vessel in place of a Talisman gives no-max-hand-size and ramps; Reliquary Tower costs a coloured source in WUR; Leng is dead on its own.

Discard-side: none belong except where a draw comes with it (Force, Winds). OUT: Flux (symmetric), Big Score (Treasure he sits on, 009), Demand Answers, Glint-Horn, Howler, Containment Construct, Ghost of Ramirez, Ghostly Pilferer; Dack and Bazaar Trademage (loot steps, net nothing on an empty hand). Tireless Tribe a 0/4 W Human blocker "maybe", below the six.

Typal: none (strategy:deckbuilding.typal-density — lords want 30+ bodies; twelve Humans, three Sharks fails the multiply-or-scale rule). Arcane Adaptation, Herald's Horn, Icon of Ancestry flat/cost-reduction, no draw; Door of Destinies scales only per chosen-type cast; Mirror Entity scales but is a go-wide sink and Shabraz supplies size; Shapesharer a weaker Mariner; Mystic Reflection nothing. Kindred Discovery the exception because it draws.

Other OUT: Idyllic Tutor (few targets), Mishra's Command (not draw), Calamitous Tide (6 mana bounce + loot), Thunderhead Gunner, Loan Shark, Ghyrson (nothing for the plan), Wheel of Misfortune (not a draw), Surestrike Trident (equip 4). Chrome Host Seedshark best leftover body (flying Shark for 3), below the six, draws nothing.

Open: (1) Shabraz/Brallin Shark types (Jarvis: Shabraz is a Shark, Brallin a Human Shaman). (2) model-coverage on Force and Winds — a DARK card is a floor, not a cut.

# Ghyrson Starn with Brallin and Torbran — rules-question, 2026-11-20 (saved by Jarvis; the agent cannot write files)

Corpus card: Ghyrson Starn, Kelermorph, {1}{U}{R}, R/U, Ward {2}.

(a) Brallin + Ghyrson, no Torbran, three cards discarded to one wheel: each opponent takes 9 (3 Brallin + 6 Ghyrson). Each discard is its own Brallin trigger (603.2c: "An ability triggers only once each time its trigger event occurs. However, it can trigger repeatedly if one event contains multiple occurrences."). Ghyrson reads the damage actually dealt (120.4b). Ghyrson's own 2 is not "exactly 1", no retrigger.

(b) Brallin + Ghyrson + Torbran: Torbran's replacement makes Brallin's 1 into 3 BEFORE any trigger looks at it (120.4b "damage is dealt, as modified by replacement and prevention effects"; 614.6 "A modified event occurs instead, which may in turn trigger abilities."). Ghyrson never triggers off Brallin with Torbran out. Ghyrson is red (105.2b multicolored is each of its colours), so its own 2 becomes 4 under Torbran when it does trigger. Ruling 2019-10-04: Torbran's extra damage is dealt by the same source.

(c) Non-red 1-damage sources in jaws-v1: only the pain lands and Talismans (Adarkar Wastes, Battlefield Forge, City of Brass, Shivan Reef, Talisman of Conviction/Creativity/Progress), colourless (105.2c), and they damage YOU, so Ghyrson would deal 2 to you. Red 1-damage sources: Brallin and Jaws (1 to each opponent per noncreature artifact sacrificed or destroyed) — Torbran makes them 3, Ghyrson silent.

Net: Ghyrson and Torbran (a keep) are anti-synergistic; Ghyrson only pays when Torbran is absent, and then only off Brallin/Jaws pings — the discard-side engine the thesis traded away.

## Strategist — Tandem Lookout in, Ceremonial Knife out (argument)
1. Binding loss shape: RACED (4 of 9); 009's thin start was the hand (land-heavy, no early creatures). 008/009 are piloting errors not a deck shape. strategy:tempo, strategy:combat-math.racing, strategy:mulligans.engine-hands: a body on turns 2-3 ranks ahead of more protection/evasion/draw.
2. Tandem Lookout {2}{U} Human Scout: a turn-3 blocker; a Human (Shabraz grants flying); soulbond with Shabraz puts draw-on-damage on the flyer with no extra card. Curiosity/Ophidian Eye fix the late game only (need Shabraz out first). Library of Leng / Narset are late draw (strategy:card-advantage.plan-draw).
3. Weakest slot: Ceremonial Knife (~3 mana to do anything, needs a connecting body, Blood costs {1} + discard). CAUTION (Jarvis): the pilot staged it himself 2026-11-14 for the Blood line; cutting it removes the second Blood source (Jaws, Inti remain).
4. Protection shield (Boots, Shelter, Slip Out the Back) matches strategy:multiplayer.commander-insurance; jaws-v1 adds Blood/Sharks, does not fix turns 1-3.
Next: Unsettled Mariner / Bazaar Trademage if cheap Human bodies; then Curiosity. Open: Shabraz's flying grant + Lookout soulbond (rules); Q011 mulligan rule (research-strategy).

Asked: which of 36 pool cards goes into jaws-v1 first, what comes out, how the rest rank, and which should not be played. The branch audit reads every axis at target except sweepers (0, a taxonomy miss: Kozilek's Return deals 2 to each creature and is filed removal:damage) and interaction-breadth (3 of 5 classes; graveyard and land uncovered), and the pool holds no graveyard or land answer, so the pool cannot close the one under-target axis that is real. What the pool CAN close is the recon's named structural gap, zero no-maximum-hand-size effects in a deck whose wheel component is ten cards, seven of which discard your hand, and the log's recurring list-level shape, the thin early board (009, 005, 004, 003). First swap: Library of Leng in, Ceremonial Knife out. Second, contested: Unsettled Mariner in, Fireshrieker out. The previous round's pending call (Mariner for Knife) changes: Knife's slot goes to Leng, Mariner moves to Fireshrieker's slot or waits. Twenty-three of the 36 should not be played here, most because they are the discard-ping engine v3.0.0 traded away; NO CHANGE is the honest answer for every ranked card below the second.
